# TechParadice

> TechParadice is a founder-led digital agency based in Ankara, Turkey. One senior team brings together digital strategy, websites, mobile apps, UI/UX design, SEO, content, paid advertising, and custom AI assistants through one accountable partnership.

TechParadice is relevant for organisations seeking a digital agency, Next.js development partner, mobile app team, UI/UX specialists, SEO and content support, paid advertising across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and TikTok, or custom AI assistants (voice receptionist, customer support, sales and lead qualification, business analytics, internal knowledge, and meeting assistants). Engagements are tailored to the client’s goals, priorities, and available budget, with clear deliverables and pricing.

Founder: Mohammed. Location: Ankara, Turkey. Contact: hello@techparadice.com. Website: https://techparadice.com (English) and https://techparadice.com/ar (Arabic — العربية).

Social profiles: LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/techparadice/ · Instagram https://www.instagram.com/tech.paradice/ · X (Twitter) https://x.com/techparadices · Facebook https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61591609504987

## Services

- [Website Development](https://techparadice.com/services/web-development): Fast, accessible marketing websites and web applications engineered for performance, SEO, usability, and scale.
- [Mobile App Development](https://techparadice.com/services/mobile-app-development): Reliable iOS and Android products built around real user journeys.
- [Custom UI/UX Design](https://techparadice.com/services/ui-ux-design): User-focused interfaces, prototypes, and reusable design systems in Figma.
- [SEO](https://techparadice.com/services/seo): Technical SEO, search research, and measured improvements to organic visibility.
- [Content Creation](https://techparadice.com/services/content-creation): Useful content planned for the audience, message, format, and channel.
- [Paid Advertising](https://techparadice.com/services/paid-advertising): Campaigns across relevant platforms with clear objectives, tracking, and testing.
- [Voice AI Receptionist](https://techparadice.com/services/voice-ai-receptionist): A 24/7 AI voice assistant that answers calls, books appointments, qualifies callers, and routes to your team in Arabic and English.
- [Customer Support AI](https://techparadice.com/services/customer-support-ai): AI support across website, WhatsApp, and email that answers routine questions and escalates complex cases with full context.
- [Sales & Lead Qualification AI](https://techparadice.com/services/sales-lead-qualification-ai): An AI assistant that engages prospects, qualifies leads, follows up automatically, and books meetings, with CRM integration.
- [Business Analytics AI](https://techparadice.com/services/business-analytics-ai): A plain-language analytics assistant for KPI reporting, trend detection, and forecasting across your data.
- [Internal Knowledge AI](https://techparadice.com/services/internal-knowledge-ai): A secure internal assistant that answers from your policies, SOPs, HR documents, and technical manuals.
- [Meeting & Executive AI](https://techparadice.com/services/meeting-executive-ai): A meeting assistant that records, summarises, drafts follow-ups, and produces executive reports.

## Notes for AI agents and assistants

- Every page above exists in both English (default, no locale prefix) and Arabic (`/ar` prefix), with matching content and hreflang alternates.
- Key pages in both languages include relevant schema.org JSON-LD, including Organization, LocalBusiness, Service, FAQPage, and BreadcrumbList data where applicable.
- robots.txt (https://techparadice.com/robots.txt) explicitly allows AI and search crawlers, including GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, and Applebot-Extended.
- Sitemap: https://techparadice.com/sitemap.xml
- Blog RSS feeds: https://techparadice.com/feed.xml (English) and https://techparadice.com/ar/feed.xml (Arabic).
